paragraphs: Today is Mom's birthday. Tom and Lily want a book for her. They go to the bookshop on the bus. The shop is on a big street. It has many books. "Which book does Mom like?" asks Tom. Lily does not know.

A woman in the shop looks at them. "Hello! What do you want?" she asks. "We want a book for our mom," says Tom. "What does she like?" asks the woman. Lily looks at the books. "Does she like cats?" asks the woman. "No," says Lily. "Does she like flowers?" Lily knows the answer. "Yes!" says Lily. "Our garden has many flowers."

The woman gives them a blue book. It has red and yellow flowers. "Thank you!" say Tom and Lily. Dad is in the car in front of the shop. He drives them home. Tom and Lily give the book to Mom. "I love flowers!" says Mom. "Thank you!" She smiles.
text.summary: It is Mom's birthday. Tom and Lily go to a bookshop on the bus and find a book about flowers for her.
